integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically from the defining equation, multiplicativity of sigma, parity of prime-power divisor sums, and the standard 2-adic lifting identity. Finite computation is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes the hyperperfect number itself is odd; it does not prove oddness for all odd indices and does not settle the conjectured two-prime form.
title: Euler-form restriction for odd odd-index hyperperfect numbers
